evidence.observation: Purge brought O2 down from about 28,800 ppm to 15 ppm, and it has stayed at 3.5–8 ppm through the ramp and growth.
Measured flow followed the setpoint change from 200 to 100 sccm and has held at 98.6–100.9 sccm since, so the MFC is responding, not stuck.
Temperature overshot by 10 °C at the start of growth, then settled at 750 ±1 °C by t=2640–3240 s.
Heater power has been steady at 39–46% during growth, which is consistent with the thermocouple reading.
No pressure gauge is installed, so tube pressure cannot be checked directly.

args.missing_evidence: No characterization of the sample yet (for example Raman, optical microscopy or XRD). Without a pressure gauge, an exhaust blockage can only be detected indirectly.
